item.text: {"rule":"A two-stage elimination was used: after two cards were tapped, either that pair or its complement remained; after one of the remaining cards was tapped, either it or the other card remained. The keep/discard choice varied across rounds—even for the same selections—so the observations are insufficient to infer a deterministic rule for those choices."}
